title.narrative: Approved institutional framework for implementing the National Decentralization Strategy including inter-ministerial coordination and cooperation mechanisms.

description.narrative: Approved institutional framework for implementing the National Decentralization Strategy including inter-ministerial coordination and cooperation mechanisms.

comment.narrative: Technical support is provided for the newly composed decentralization and local administration reform committee (Prime Minister headed one); communication with the members of the inter-ministerial committee for local administration reform (Ministry of Finance, Central Agency for Organization and Administration, Ministry of Planning) is initiated.

Technical support is provided for the newly composed decentralization and local administration reform committee (Prime Minister headed one). The technical committee composed of six members from Ministries: Ministry of Finance (MoF), Ministry of Planning and Economic Development (MoPED), and Central Agency for Organization and Administration (CAOA) held the first technical meeting as preparatory work to pave the road for the kick-off of the inter-ministerial committee for local administration reform paving the road for decentralization.
Operationalize the institutional framework for implementing the National Decentralization Strategy including inter-ministerial coordination and cooperation mechanisms

The foundations laid by the strategic and legislative reforms will directly support the formation of an institutional coordination mechanism for decentralization. Future reporting periods are expected to focus on establishing inter-ministerial coordination platforms, including working groups and monitoring systems to support the implementation of decentralization policies.
Operationalize the institutional framework for implementing the National Decentralization Strategy including inter-ministerial coordination and cooperation mechanisms

description.narrative: Develop a National Rural Development Strategy (post-Hayah Kareema Vision).

Technical support is provided to the Ministry of Local Development in developing a National Rural Development Strategy. Four ToRs were drafted for individual consultants to carry out a study on Hayah Kareema Initiative in preparation for the national rural development strategy.
Develop a national rural development strategy

The past year has been one of high engagement and activity; it included strategic preparation, transforming ambitious goals for National Rural Development into concrete, actionable achievements. While the full strategy mission is just beginning, the project foundational work has set the stage for an integrated and sustainable approach that directly supports Egypt's Vision 2030.

description.narrative: Endorsed MoLD Strategic Plan including a Policy Framework for Local Development

A draft strategic plan was developed along with a communications strategy

A strategic plan for MoLD and a multi-sectoral policy framework for local development as well as a climate change strategy for MoLD is developed. A Request for Proposal (RFP) for development of MoLD Strategic Plan is finalized and published, and accordingly suitable vendors are selected. Technical support is provided for governorates in the implementation plans for their respective plans. Additionally, consultation workshops with MoLD leadership, governorates, and central authorities, are conducted.

In light of the adjusted implementation modality from individual consultants to consulting firms, the Request for Proposal (RFP) for MoLD Strategic Plan and Climate Change Strategy was finalized and advertised. Accordingly 1 vendor was selected and kickstarted the work. A meeting was conducted to discuss detailed plan for the stakeholder engagement and one-on-one interviews for MoLD strategic plan and the climate change strategy. Technical support has been provided for governorates in the implementation of their respective plans. The strategic plan for MoLD and a multi-sectoral policy framework for local development as well as a climate change strategy for MoLD is currently under progress.

title.narrative: Endorsed and applied institutional development of MoLD in line with its strategic plan, the local development policy framework and developed local development systems

description.narrative: Endorsed and applied institutional development of MoLD in line with its strategic plan, the local development policy framework and developed local development systems

comment.narrative: Number of SOPs developed for the new organizational structure
During the reporting period, the consultancy assignment for implementing the structure and developing the three priority SOPs has been formally launched.

A rapid assessment of the special units developed at MoLD as well as technical assessments of human resources (starting with central departments), are initiated. A phased action plan to apply the new organizational structure is developed and implemented through a consultancy firm. Additionally, workshops are conducted for MoLD leadership and staff to disseminate the new organizational structure.

MoLD now has guidelines for recruitment and selection of leadership positions at the Ministry. Further, the ministry now has finalized a Human Resources assessment for all its specialized units, with special focus on priority units like the Human Rights Unit and Equal Opportunity Unit. This crucial unit now has an approved organizational structure, including job descriptions and mandates, contributing to improved responsiveness of local governance institutions.

title.narrative: Issuance of Public Administration Law and General Planning Law

description.narrative: Issuance of Public Administration Law and General Planning Law

comment.narrative: A legal review and analysis of the legislative framework for local development is conducted.

A legal review and analysis of the legislative framework for local development is under progress. A Request for Proposal (RFP) for the legislative review process is being developed. After carrying out the exploratory workshops on decentralization, the project redirected the scope and nature of deliverables based on the recommendations provided during the workshops.
Consolidate a legislative framework for local development and local administration through the finalization of relevant laws

To support a conducive legal framework for decentralization, the Law Committee was established by H.E. Minister of Local Development Manal Awad to draft the new Local Administration Law. The project engaged the Institute of National Planning to support the Committee in reviewing relevant legislation, identifying overlapping or conflicting provisions, and preparing the draft law for submission to Parliament.
Consolidate a legislative framework for local development and local administration through the finalization of relevant laws

A Geographic Information System (GIS) and Digital Transformation consultant is contracted to assess the four governorates' and MoLD's GIS capacities and design internal and connecting GIS systems and linked units or departments. Field visits to the four governorates are conducted, as part of the evaluation of the GIS units.

comment.narrative: Priority LED interventions are projects are identified in at least 2 governorates; 2 governorates' strategic plans for 2030 incorporating LED strategies are developed through contracting consulting firms. Priority LED interventions are now identified in the 4 pilot governorates. Over 100 members of socio-economic councils (representatives from private sector and civil society organizations) in 4 governorates verified the selection and feasibility of 4 LED interventions, aiming to benefit 200,000 SMEs in agri-industries in Fayoum and Beni Suef. A consulting firm was contracted for the development of the Fayoum & Beni-Suef strategic plans for 2030.

title.narrative: Updated National Strategy for Decentralization and Reform of the Local Administration System

description.narrative: Updated National Strategy for Decentralization and Reform of the Local Administration System

comment.narrative: Development of a decentralization strategy (administrative, economic, fiscal) is initiated. A draft Request for Proposal (RFP) for the consultancy firm to carry out the development of the decentralization strategy, is finalized and advertised, and reviewed by the Ministry. Additionally, consultation sessions with governorates and multi-stakeholder workshops with experts and central agencies are conducted.

Development of a decentralization strategy (administrative, economic, and fiscal) is initiated. The project conducted three exploratory workshops during the reporting period towards decentralization in Egypt, to gain insights from diverse stakeholder groups on alternatives and paths to the transition to decentralization in its financial, administrative, and economic aspects, within the framework of the latest developments and challenges facing the implementation of decentralization. A draft Request for Proposal (RFP) for the consultancy firm to carry out the development of the decentralization strategy has been drafted and in the process of review by the Ministry.
Proposal for the amendment of the local Administrative Law developed

To support a conducive legal framework for decentralization, the Law Committee was established by H.E. Minister of Local Development Manal Awad to draft the new Local Administration Law. The project engaged the Institute of National Planning to support the Committee in reviewing relevant legislation, identifying overlapping or conflicting provisions, and preparing the draft law for submission to Parliament.
Proposal for the amendment of the local Administrative Law developed
Percentage increase in OSR in four governorates

Progress was achieved in enhancing the Own-Source Revenues (OSR) system. Key developments included the formulation of an OSR guideline, launch of governorate-level OSR assessments, formation of OSR committees by governorate decrees OSR manual, annual action plans, and high-level capacity building workshops to track implementation progress. In Luxor, successful acceleration of own-resource revenues by 110%.

The integrated local planning system at pilot governorates and all districts is applied to enhance the quality of the capital investment plan (project profile, pre-feasibility study, social & environmental templates, ..etc). Experience is exchanged with other governorates (peer-to-peer learning) on reformed local planning. Additionally, technical support is provided to review the investment plan for the fiscal year 2024/2023 in the pilot governorates. In support of the Project, local planning committees are formed at the four pilot governorates and their affiliated centers.

Technical support was provided to review the investment plan for the fiscal year 2023/2024 in the four pilot governorates, as well as technical support to review the investment plan for the fiscal year 2024/2025 in the four pilot governorates. Local planning committees were formed at the four pilot governorates. Orientation sessions were organized for the Local planning committees at the governorate level in their roles and responsibility to support the planning departments for the four pilot governorates. Additionally, three workshops for exchanging and replication of the planning reforms were conducted with representatives with total number of members around 150 employees from the four pilot governorates, UELDP and Decent Life initiative.
